description: This file defines the ConnectionFactory interface in Java for creating AMQP 1.0 connections, providing methods for establishing connections with optional handlers and configuration.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for establishing AMQP 1.0 connections, with methods for getting connection parameters and initiating connections.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container ID name used in the AMQP Open frame, or null if not set.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address of the server to connect to.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the server.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character used for separating path components in target addresses.

methods.name: connect (overload 1)
methods.description: Establishes a connection with the server using optional client options and handlers for close and disconnect events, as well as a result handler.

methods.name: connect (overload 2)
methods.description: Establishes a connection with the server using client options, username, password, and handlers for events and result.
